title: Affine quadric: selective Lean 4 formalization
description: Selective Lean 4 companion formalization for Hamiltonian Desingularization, Collision Asymptotics, and Exact Critical Modes for Cohomogeneity-One IIB Solitons on the Affine Quadric. The repository documents exact mathematical hypotheses and external boundaries in FORMALIZATION_SCOPE.md. Lean 4.24.0 and all dependencies are pinned. The companion preprint DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23956688 is reserved in a Zenodo draft; the paper is not yet published and the DOI has not yet been definitively registered. This is the paper DOI, not the software DOI. The software DOI remains pending.
